title: Unit Event — No seek No find — Episode7 Until I Get These Feelings Out

meta.Episode: Episode7 — Until I Get These Feelings Out
meta.Event Outline: Leo/need has decided to perform at a new live house to take the next step in their journey. Saki writes a new song to play at the show, but it doesn't seem to resonate with the audience at all...

rows.Line: That night
Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I have to keep trying...
They're all counting on me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I have to write a song that resonates with that crowd. And absolutely have to make our next show a success...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, here we go!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, I'll stop here for my draft of the first verse and come back to it after working on the rest...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hnng... My shoulders are getting all stiff from sitting in the same position for so long!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! I've already spent two hours working on this?! I guess time flies when you're really focused...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hm?
Who is it?

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: I see you're hard at work, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Mom!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What's up?
Wait, are you carrying...?

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Honami just stopped by and dropped off a midnight snack for you. I think she made it herself.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Really?!
And she came all this way to deliver it?

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Yes.
She even said, “I wanted to help Saki somehow since she's trying her absolute best.”

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. She really is a wonderful friend.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hona...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
B-But she left already, right?
You could've told me a little sooner...

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: I tried to get her to stay but she said that she didn't want to interrupt you as you worked.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: I'll be rooting for you as well, so keep at it. I'll leave the snack Honami made right here.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay...
Thanks, Mom!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. You're such a nice person, Hona. I wonder what you made for me...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh wow...!
Sandwiches packed with lots of fruits!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
She even wrote a little message for me.
“Thought you'd be craving something sweet while you're working, so I hope you enjoy these.”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's so sweet.
I'll take a pic and show these off to everyone! And I should message her later to thank her!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Now, Hona's given me a boost of energy, so let's get back to work!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Oh, it's already this late...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (It's about eighty percent done, but it still isn't exactly what I imagined...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I have to keep tweaking how it sounds. It needs to match how I felt back then...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
How about this phrase here...?
No, I can go down half a step and make it sound a little darker...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's closer but still not what I'm looking for... There has to be a better chord...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What if I switched to a major key just for this part? As it stands, it just doesn't fit in right...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh...? It's already this late? I only wanted to sleep for thirty minutes but ended up sleeping for three hours...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
It's okay. Just stay calm...
Rushing isn't the answer.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I still have time, so I can keep trying different sounds...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I'll be fine... Let's get back to work.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, it still doesn't feel right...
I got stuck in the same spot yesterday. Something just seems off about it...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
It needs to feel sadder...
No, it has to be about the despair that lies ahead, I think...? Like wanting everyone to just go away...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hmm... I'm so close...
Just a little bit more and it's gonna be so good...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Uh oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I felt a little light-headed just now...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Maybe I should stop for now...
Shiho and the others said that I shouldn't push myself too hard.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But I have to finish this...
I have to do it now... Or else, I probably won't be able to produce a good sound...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huh?
It's so late. Who's sending me a message...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What...?!
It's Shiho and Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. They sent me messages at the exact same time! Talk about a coincidence! Maybe it's fate...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's see... Shiho said...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
<Are you still working, Saki?
I figured that you'd get stuck about now, so I decided to let you know that you're free to ask for help whenever.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha. Shiho knows me so well.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <I just got an idea for this one part. I'll let you know if it doesn't work out. Thanks♪>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
They're still up this late...
They must be really worried.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Especially Ichi...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huh? A picture...?
Of what...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
<How's your song going?
Maybe you can open your window for a breath of fresh air. The stars looks really pretty tonight.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
<What do you see, Saki?
Can you see the same stars in the picture?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line:
<Ichi.
I can see a little ice cream cone from here.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika's Message
rows.Line: <Really?! That's incredible...!>

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: I'm looking up at the same sky as Ichi...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: It's like we're sitting right next to each other...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's the same as that time...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Even when I got sick, they'd all make me feel better by sending me messages like this...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (For as long as I can remember, I hated how my body wouldn't do what I wanted it to...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (However...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (They kept my spirits up by saying, “You're not alone.”)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (They showed me that there's a fun future waiting for me up ahead.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Even when I started hating everything else, I held onto that...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (The hope of really living life each and every day...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That's what I felt...
I was someone who just wasn't able to live a normal life.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And that's what I have to convey.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
“You're not alone.”
“There's a fun future ahead.”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's how I'll understand their loneliness...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I can do it...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I can make this song better... A lot better.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I can keep going...!!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Saki...
She seems so focused.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<And this melody...
It's kind of nice.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah, I think she finally found what she was looking for.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I can't wait to hear the finished product.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I-It's finished...!
My song's done...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I want everyone to hear it ASAP...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, huh...?
It's already morning...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh no!
Everyone's supposed to come over to talk about our next show...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, that must be them...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm so glad I finished this in time...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
This song...
I need them to hear it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hang on! I'll be right there!
